items.stem: 'Clean topology' in polygon modelling generally favours:

options.text: Evenly distributed quads that deform and subdivide predictably
options.rationale: Correct: quad-based topology deforms and subdivides cleanly.
N-gons cause shading and deformation problems.
Triangles can pinch on deforming surfaces.
Edge flow is central to clean topology.

items.explanation: Correct: quad-based topology deforms and subdivides cleanly.

items.stem: Which TWO of the classic animation principles most directly control an object's sense of weight? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Timing (how many frames an action takes)
options.rationale: Correct: timing conveys mass and force.

options.text: Spacing / slow-in and slow-out (how the frames are distributed)
options.rationale: Correct: spacing shapes acceleration and perceived weight.
Resolution is unrelated to motion weight.

items.explanation: Correct: timing conveys mass and force.

options.text: Flattening a 3D model's surface into 2D coordinates so textures map correctly
options.rationale: Correct: UVs map 2D texture space onto the 3D surface.

options.text: Adding more polygons to a model
